description: Compute the debt-to-income ratio (total monthly debt payments / gross monthly income) from one or more monthly debt items, plus a qualitative tier matching common mortgage-lending guidance: under 36% is healthy, under 43% is moderate (43% is the back-end ratio ceiling many mortgage lenders use), under 50% is high, and 50%+ is severe. This is a back-end DTI (all monthly debt payments over gross income), not a front-end housing-only ratio.

debts.description: A non-empty list of monthly debt payments

amount.description: Monthly payment amount for this debt

name: calculate_debt_to_income_ratio
